verdict.rationale: Convex schemas are defined as code (schema.ts) and the CLI automatically pushes new schema/function versions to a deployment when files change, and `npx convex deploy`-style CLI usage implies these changes can be scripted for CI (convex-docs-6, convex-docs-17, convex-docs-18, convex-probe-5, convex-probe-6). However, Convex has no distinct 'migration' abstraction (no migration files, versioning, or rollback tooling) and there is no explicit documentation of running schema pushes inside a CI pipeline. Missing for 10: explicit migration-file/versioning system, documented CI integration example, and rollback/history tooling for schema changes.
